steps.title: MOVE THE MAP
steps.text: Hold and drag the map a little. On a computer, use the left mouse button.

steps.title: CHANGE THE SCALE
steps.text: Pinch to change the scale. On a computer, use the wheel or trackpad.

steps.title: SELECT YOUR TANK
steps.text: Tap your tank near the Yard. Its selection marker shows it is ready for an order.

steps.title: GIVE A MOVE ORDER
steps.text: With your tank selected, tap nearby open ground. Wait for the tank to move.

steps.title: CLEAR THE SELECTION
steps.text: Select your tank if needed, then tap CLEAR. Its current order stays in place.

steps.title: ATTACK THE ENEMY
steps.text: Select your tank, then tap the enemy soldier east of your base. Let the tank reach it and fire.

steps.title: ENTER THE YARD
steps.text: Clear any unit selection, then tap your Construction Yard twice to enter.

steps.title: PREVIEW CONCRETE
steps.text: Tap the Concrete item once. Check its picture and price before buying.

steps.title: START CONSTRUCTION
steps.text: Tap the same Concrete item again to start construction.

steps.title: RETURN TO THE MAP
steps.text: If the building screen is still open, tap EXIT. Otherwise you are already back on the map. Construction continues at the Yard.

steps.title: WAIT FOR OK
steps.text: Wait until the Yard shows OK. Your Concrete is ready to place.

steps.title: PLACE THE CONCRETE
steps.text: Press the ready Yard and drag the Concrete onto rock. Use the placement grid, then release on an allowed site.

steps.title: SELECT THE HARVESTER
steps.text: Look north of the base and tap your Harvester.

steps.title: COLLECT SPICE
steps.text: Tap the spice just east of the Harvester. Wait until it has collected some spice.

steps.title: DELIVER THE SPICE
steps.text: If it has not returned automatically, clear any selection. Select the Harvester and tap your Refinery. Wait for it to unload and add credits.

steps.title: TRAINING COMPLETE
steps.text: You have moved, fought, built and harvested. Return to the main menu when you are ready.
